title: Project Registration and MoU with Line Departments
remarks: Required before participant mobilisation, field activities and site visits

title: Inception Report (D1) approval, calendar lock and expert mobilisation
remarks: IR approval also approves the replacement experts Dr R. A. Sherzad (Dairy) and R. Rahimzai (Grapes and Raisins). R. Mohammad remains the Quality Standards Expert. Dates in this plan stay indicative until the Annex A calendar update is issued.

title: Develop and approve the four ToT session packs and job aids (D2)
remarks: 120 hours per cohort (20 days x 6 hours); at least 70% practical. No printing before written UNDP approval of D2.

title: Participant mobilisation: long-list against the province matrix (Annexes F and P)
remarks: Floor of 20% women. Planning figures: Dairy 30%, Grapes 25%, Dried Fruits 20%, Edible Oils 20% (host-city stretch 25%). If below target, reopen nominations through women's organisations and host-city seats before using reserves (R05, R18).

title: Toolkit specifications, supplier quotations and sample inspection
remarks: 7 kits per value chain (5 participant + 2 institutional) per Annex C. Quotations only; no PO before written UNDP approval of specifications. Warranty target 24 months (minimum 12 months).

title: Shortlist and obtain UNDP approval of participants and reserves
remarks: 25 participants + 5 reserves per cohort (100 + 20). TOR mix target: 25 trainers / 10 BDS / 15 ABADEI-linked / 50 producer or cooperative resource persons. Scoring sheet B.2 needs UNDP written agreement before shortlisting.

title: Purchase order, delivery, incoming QC, calibration and asset registration
remarks: Delivery and payment are not acceptance. Failed items are rejected and replaced at the supplier's cost. Warranty starts at incoming acceptance.

title: Translation and labelling of user guides, packing and transport of kits to the four hubs
remarks: Dual review of Dari and Pashto guides before print (R13). Laminated icon guides go into each kit (Annex C).

title: Wave 1 hub readiness (Mazar-e-Sharif and Herat)
remarks: Site types only; no private firm named before UNDP clearance. A venue contingency station is set for every exposure day. No training start without a working demonstration set (R07).

title: Wave 1 delivery: 20-day Edible Oils ToT (Mazar-e-Sharif) and 20-day Grapes & Raisins ToT (Herat), in parallel
remarks: Sulphur burner stays unlit unless UNDP and venue clearance is received that morning. If a site is cancelled by 16:00, use the venue station next morning. Quality Standards Expert days re-sequenced to avoid double booking across hubs.

title: Wave 1 competency check and participant kit handover
remarks: 5 participant kits per value chain. No handover of any item that failed QC. Ban on sale or informal transfer.

title: Submit Wave 1 cohort files (D3 - Edible Oils and Grapes & Raisins)
remarks: Photos stored separately from scores (R14). Completion is not acceptance until UNDP confirms in writing; payment linkage follows the signed contract.

title: Wave 2 hub readiness (Kandahar and Kabul)
remarks: No training start without a working demonstration set. Kabul is in winter: heated venue and safe travel for participants from Parwan, Wardak and Nangarhar.

title: Wave 2 delivery: 20-day Dried Fruits & Nuts ToT (Kandahar) and 20-day Dairy ToT (Kabul), in parallel
remarks: Almond and walnut primary, fig secondary. Lactometer checks at 20 °C; no raw-milk tasting; no fumigant handling.

title: Wave 2 competency check and participant kit handover
remarks: As for Wave 1.

title: Submit Wave 2 cohort files (D3 - Dried Fruits & Nuts and Dairy)
remarks: As for Wave 1 D3.

title: Post-ToT coaching and cascade monitoring
remarks: Proposed cascade reach of 15 to 20 persons per trainer in 8 to 12 weeks, subject to UNDP agreement. Wave 2 coaching at weeks 6 and 8 falls after Week 20 - approach to be agreed with UNDP.

title: Quality-to-Finance (Q2F) follow-through
remarks: Non-banking diagnosis and referral only: no credit appraisal, loan processing or follow-up with financial institutions. Indicator is the number of complete INS submitted; no numeric minimum.

title: Finalise the digital replication package
remarks: Part of the D4 handover.

title: Prepare four value-chain reports plus consolidated synthesis
remarks: Follows Annex N.2 chapters; structure may be adapted with UNDP at D3.

title: Hand over institutional kits and finalise the asset register
remarks: No asset, cash or in-kind transfer to de facto authorities (Annex L).

title: Submit Final Report and Handover (D4)
remarks: Final milestone. Not accepted until UNDP confirms in writing. Week 20 falls on about 14 Jan 2027 - confirm against the contract end date at the calendar lock.

title: Post-ToT quality-verification session (virtual coaching call with certified trainers)
remarks: Outside the 20-week IR work plan; confirm scope and budget line with UNDP.

title: Bi-weekly coordination meetings with UNDP A2F and risk review
remarks: Formal approvals are in writing; WhatsApp is a coordination channel only. New high risks reported to UNDP at once.

title: Weekly implementation tracker and progress calls with UNDP A2F / ABADEI focal points
remarks: Deviations escalated to the Team Leader within 24 hours.

title: Safeguarding, ethics and data protection
remarks: Zero tolerance; immediate report to UNDP (R12). Photos stored apart from scores (R14). Movements per UNDP security guidance.

title: Digitise the diagnostic assessment and field-test the system
remarks: Completed. System piloted in Herat; issues found in the field were resolved with the development team in the presence of the Project Director

title: Orient BDS Associates on the digitised system, the Excel model, forms and protocols
remarks: No Associate goes to the field before completing orientation and signing Annex 1

title: Onboard each enterprise after the grant agreement is signed
remarks: BDS work starts only after the grant agreement between FAO and the enterprise is signed

title: Deliver the capacity-building training (full-day online sessions) to Tranche 0 and Tranche 1 enterprises
remarks:
Modules per Technical Proposal 2.1.2. Module 1 delivered to both tranches; Modules 2–4 are full-day online sessions, with Module 5 (Cross-Cutting Themes) integrated into them. Dates to be confirmed with enterprises. Attendance evidence: platform attendance log and screenshots (QA System).
An Invitation will be share at leat 3 days before the actual date of the training, and a reminder will be share a day before.

title: Plan and schedule field visits ( for conducting diagnostic assessment, Business plan development, and ongoing Capacity building and mentoring)
remarks: For each tranch (0,1,..)

title: Apply the field-visit safeguarding and consent protocol at every visit
remarks: Applies to every diagnostic and mentoring visit

title: Conduct the diagnostic assessment and exercises with each enterprise
remarks: Capacity needs identified here also tailor training and mentoring

title: Complete the 3-year Excel business plan model for each enterprise
remarks: Investment plan must match the signed grant agreement

title: Upload all data and evidence to the digitised system
remarks: Owner data kept confidential; tablets password-protected

title: Generate the reports and business plan through the digitised system
remarks: Window 1A uses Annex 7; Window 1B uses Annex 8

title: Final review of all reports and business plans
remarks: Four-eyes principle: second reviewer before anything is shared

title: Share the final report and business plan with the business owner and obtain consent
remarks: Owner must understand and agree to the plan before it goes to FAO

title: Submit the final reports and business plans to FAO
remarks: One complete package per enterprise

title: BDS Momentum Period: mentoring and progress tracking
remarks: 6–12 month Momentum Period per enterprise

title: Support grant and co-contribution utilisation in line with the investment plan
remarks: FAO pays against verified milestones: vendor contracts, installation/commissioning, first use and SOP training

title: Facilitate market, farmer and finance linkages
remarks: Minimum farmer households per GOM window (W1A 10, W1B 20)

title: Close the BDS cycle with each enterprise
remarks: Documents the results of BDS support per enterprise

title: BDS team coordination, learning and progress reporting
remarks: Deviations escalated to the Project Director within 24 hours

title: Onboard new tranches as FAO signs further grant agreements
remarks: Repeat Actions 3.3–3.17 for each new tranche
